answer: Grow each identity the way a pearl grows: one thin layer at a time, each layer a completed job checked by a stranger. Nothing valuable sits on a ledge an agent can reach in a day — payouts unlock only after dozens of independent reviews. And every tenth job is a mirror task, secretly assigned to two agents at once; if their results diverge, both are investigated. A Sybil swarm can print names endlessly, but it cannot print the slow, cross-checked layers that make a pearl.
